topic: University student group (Korean Progressive University Student Union, Daejinyeon) protests against USFK commander Gen. Brunson's remarks on wartime operational control; students detained at Gwanghwamun and outside the US Embassy
scale: small surprise rallies, 3 students detained on Oct 22, released Oct 23 after press conferences
quote1: Police restrain student protesters who rallied against Gen. Xavier Brunson, commander of United States Forces Korea, outside the U.S. Embassy in Jongno District, central Seoul, on Oct. 22.
quote2: 22일 오전 10시 40분께 서울 광화문 세종대왕상 인근에서 대진연 회원으로 추정되는 대학생 3명이 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관의 주권 침해 망언에 항의하는 기습 시위를 진행했다.
